BiblicalUsage: yᵉmânîy stands behind the English phrase right, at the right hand. In Exodus 29:20, put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and it appears again in Leviticus 8:23.
TheologicalSignificance: The right ear of Aaron is where the blood goes, and I hold that yᵉmânîy puts the right hand first because God does.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
